cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

mechanism: A conducts forgiveness as a precise settlement, correcting B assumptions about what holiday time purchases before pricing genuine feelings separately.
confusable: Mere grudge-holding with demands lacks explicit exchange; A must treat apology, declared feelings and actual feelings as negotiable services.
comparison: Ladder alternative negotiates friendship within an equipment loan; this one bargains over family reassurance and genuine reconciliation.
seedUse: Missed birthday, Christmas dates and actual hurt derive from D22-b; S03 supplies precise scope corrections to the emotional bargain.
